title: velocityOffset
author: JG
description: add velocity offset to all spring dampers in order to replace many user functions with preStepUserFunctions
releaseNotes: CoordinateSpringDamper, CartesianSpringDamper and RigidBodySpringDamper have velocityOffset, so a damper is driven with a velocity instead of a user function (revision2026c step RG11.9)
